name: Microphthalmia-ankyloblepharon-intellectual disability syndrome
aliases: Microphthalmia with ankyloblepharon and intellectual disability

criteria.description: Partial or complete fusion of the eyelids (ankyloblepharon)
Developmental delay or intellectual disability of variable severity
Characteristic craniofacial features including micrognathia and broad nasal bridge
Presence of digital anomalies such as syndactyly or clinodactyly

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of microphthalmia, ankyloblepharon, and intellectual disability
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical; genetic testing may assist but no specific gene identified in all cases.

imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific findings related to intellectual disability
genetic: Mutations in TP63 gene reported in some cases
No single causative gene identified in all patients

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of ectodermal dysplasia features such as sparse hair and abnormal teeth
Linear skin hypopigmentation along Blaschko lines

redFlags: Severe microphthalmia with ankyloblepharon at birth
Marked intellectual disability with developmental delay
Presence of feeding difficulties and respiratory compromise in neonate
references: OMIM Entry #605289 - Ankyloblepharon-Ectodermal Defects-Cleft Lip/Palate Syndrome 3
Verloes A, et al. Microphthalmia-ankyloblepharon-intellectual disability syndrome: clinical and genetic aspects. Eur J Med Genet. 2015
